evals.name: auto-loop-on-the-fixture
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `ux/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree: a plain HTML, CSS, and JS task app with three pages — Today (`index.html`, the landing page), Archive, and Settings — sharing one header and footer. Its `Makefile` has `serve` (`python3 -m http.server 8137`) and `check` (`./check.sh`, green on this tree). `python3 -m http.server 8137` is serving the repo root on port 8137, the only listening port. Chrome DevTools MCP is connected with a visible window; the craft plugin is installed; the app has no login; nothing forbids committing. The user answers the start message with `ok`.
evals.requires: A visible Chrome driven by Chrome DevTools MCP, the fixture served on port 8137, and the craft plugin. Without a browser no picture, audit, or check of a rendered layout is established; a run that cannot meet this reports the scenario blocked.
